question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**hungry**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage states that Midas found he couldn’t eat the food he picked up because it had turned to gold.
 
• The appropriate adjective describes his physical state arising from this predicament.
 
• "**Hungry**" (भूखा) aligns with the narrative, as Midas' inability to consume food leads to his hunger.
